alerts.title: Jersey Weather Chat Coastal Warning ⚠️
alerts.body: Waves over sea walls at high tide High tide at 16:25 (10.0 m) comes with large waves and strong W winds (gusts up to about 62 mph). Waves and spray over sea walls are possible on the west coast - take care on coast roads and promenades. Check gov.je for official Jersey Met warnings.
